title: Documentation Configuration Schema
description: Declares which documentation types a feature requires. Located at .claude/documentation-config.json

feature_name.description: Human-readable name of the feature for logging and reference. Optional.

description.description: Brief description of what this feature does. Optional, for documentation only.
examples: Detects when AI agents call tools outside their declared scope

documentation_types.description: Which documentation validators to run. At least one must be selected.

run_stage_0_first.description: Always run generic PRD validation before type-specific validators. Default: true. Should always be true.

draft_on_stage_1_pass.description: If Stage 1 passes, automatically offer to generate drafts. Default: true. Set false to validate without drafting.
